## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user problem and what changes. Link an issue or explain the acceptance example.

## Validation

List relevant checks/results and material limitations. For regressions, show fresh current-code
execution rather than historical playback. For UI changes, include keyboard/narrow-screen evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope, behavior and compatibility/privacy effects are explained.
- [ ] Relevant tests and docs/changelog are updated, or a reason they are unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] No keys, raw private traces, run artifacts or proprietary code are included.
- [ ] Cases remain data; review checks, fixture matching and incomplete/error outcomes are preserved.
- [ ] Any dependency change includes lockfile and license-inventory updates.
- [ ] I have rights to contribute this material under the applicable file/project license.
- [ ] New external-contribution commits carry my DCO sign-off; material AI/copied-source provenance is disclosed.

Do not put vulnerability or conduct-report details in a public PR. Follow SECURITY.md / SUPPORT.md.
